LanguageData.UN_Central_ConsoleDescription: Open the local UN dashboard. No power or operator required. Settings are under Options → Mod settings → UN Peacekeepers.
LanguageData.UN_Central_NoPrisonAction: No negative prison conditions currently observed.
LanguageData.UN_Central_Forecast: Expected change if conditions remain unchanged
LanguageData.UN_Central_ForecastNote: Prison assessment snapshot including existing grace periods. New violations, prisoner arrivals or departures can change the outcome.
LanguageData.UN_Central_ActivityRules: INACTIVITY\n\nTen days without accepting a new UN mission: −10 goodwill, never below +50. Acceptance resets the interval; completion and radio contact do not. No penalty at +50 or below. New games and migration start with a full interval.
LanguageData.UN_Central_AccessRules:
ACCESS THRESHOLDS
Goodwill|Access
0|Ordinary UN orders
+50|Advanced UN orders
+75 and alliance|Reinforcements when deployment conditions are met; existing three-day cooldown, no goodwill charge
+80|Elite orders
+100 for 15 uninterrupted days|Permanent UN equipment manufacturing authorization. Ongoing probation resets below +100.
−50 or worse|Military intervention against the colony
LanguageData.UN_Central_InterventionRules:
MILITARY ESCALATION
Goodwill|Strength|Interval
−50|×1.5|12 days
−65|×2|9 days
−80|×3|6 days
−90|×4|4 days
−100|×5|3 days

Values interpolate between thresholds. First intervention after one day; subsequent timing starts from the last successful raid. Above −50 no new interventions begin. Actual storyteller points are multiplied by the goodwill factor and UN raid strength setting.
LanguageData.UN_Central_InactivityDue: Next inactivity penalty without a new acceptance
LanguageData.UN_Central_EnvironmentAction: Own pollution: next separate environmental penalty
LanguageData.UN_Central_EnvironmentNote: Only reliably attributed player-caused cells still polluted on home maps. Pre-existing pollution and unknown sources are not attributed. This global assessment is independent of individual prisoners.
